note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SAU 9; A06b SAU 9; L05 SAU 13(a)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)), A01b (descent, born abroad: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from the father only, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Saudi Arabia, 2024
sources.said: Person has had a permanent resident permit (iqama) inside the Kingdom for 5 years continuously as a minimum. Note that under article 20 of the citizenship law it states that residency period will be reset if the applicant after filing his application left the kingdom for more than 12 months using his existing passport, or if before filing his application they left the kingdom for more than 6 months. ... Proof that person will renounce his/her original citizenship required. ... Person obtains another citizenship without permission by the Prime Minister. Person is given a 3 month warning before citizenship is withdrawn. ... Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply) ... Person is born inside the Kingdom to a Saudi father, or to a Saudi mother and an unknown father; Person is born inside the Kingdom to a non-Saudi father and Saudi mother may be granted citizenship by decision of the Prime Minister following proposal by the Minister of Interior and a declaration in the year between his/her 18 and 19 years old, and fulfiling the requirements under SAU 8(a-c). ... Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply) ... Person is born abroad to a Saudi father, or to a Saudi mother and unknown father. ... No provision ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to a Saudi father, or to a Saudi mother and unknown father.
